The Ultimate CSS Gradient Maker

This CSS gradient maker is a powerful tool for creating smooth transitions between colors. Instead of relying on heavy static images, our online gradient generator lets you create dynamic, beautiful, and fast-loading backgrounds directly with CSS code. This is essential for modern UI design and creating responsive website layouts.

How to Make a CSS Gradient

Our creator simplifies the syntax for the two main types of CSS gradients: linear-gradient() and radial-gradient().

  • Linear Gradients: Colors transition along a straight line. By adjusting the Angle slider, you can easily create horizontal, vertical, or sharp diagonal blends.
  • Radial Gradients: Colors emerge from a central point outwards in a circular or elliptical shape, perfect for creating subtle vignette lighting or spotlight effects.

Finding Gradient Palettes & Inspiration

Stuck for ideas? Use the Surprise Me button as a discovery tool to uncover unique gradient color combinations. It automatically generates 2-3 stop gradients with random angles, serving as a great source of inspiration for your next SaaS dashboard, landing page hero, or mobile app UI.
